templates.title: Outline
templates.name: outline
templates.description: Outline is a self-hosted team wiki and knowledge base. This stack runs the Outline server with PostgreSQL 18 and Redis, and stores uploads on a local volume.

env.name: NODE_ENV
env.label: NODE_ENV
env.description: Production mode from the Outline env sample.

env.name: URL
env.label: URL
env.description: Public URL of this instance. Change it if you serve Outline on another address.

env.name: PORT
env.label: PORT
env.description: Port Outline listens on inside the container.

env.name: SECRET_KEY
env.label: SECRET_KEY
env.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte key used to encrypt data.

env.name: UTILS_SECRET
env.label: UTILS_SECRET
env.description: Second random secret from the env sample.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string. User, password, and database match the postgres service.

env.name: PGSSLMODE
env.label: PGSSLMODE
env.description: Disable Postgres SSL for the database on the compose network.

env.name: FILE_STORAGE
env.label: FILE_STORAGE
env.description: Store uploads on the local volume instead of S3.

env.name: FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_DIR
env.label: FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_DIR
env.description: Local upload directory. Must match the storage volume.

env.name: FILE_STORAGE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE
env.label: FILE_STORAGE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE
env.description: Maximum upload size in bytes from the env sample.

env.name: FORCE_HTTPS
env.label: FORCE_HTTPS
env.description: Do not redirect to HTTPS. This listing is served over HTTP.
